description: This file provides utility functions for manipulating bounding boxes and computing metrics such as IoU and Generalized IoU, specifically designed for object detection tasks using PyTorch. It includes functions for converting box coordinate formats, computing IoUs, and generating bounding boxes from masks.

methods.name: box_cxcywh_to_xyxy(x)
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from (center_x, center_y, width, height) format to (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max) format.

methods.name: box_xyxy_to_cxcywh(x)
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max) format to (center_x, center_y, width, height) format.

methods.name: box_iou(boxes1, boxes2)
methods.description: Computes the Intersection over Union (IoU) and union areas between two sets of boxes.

methods.name: generalized_box_iou(boxes1, boxes2)
methods.description: Calculates the Generalized IoU between two sets of bounding boxes, extending IoU to penalize non-overlapping boxes.

methods.name: masks_to_boxes(masks)
methods.description: Generates bounding boxes in xyxy format from binary masks.
